The metallographic section of RS powders is presented in Fig. 1, showing a dendritic microstructure independently of the particle size although the dendrite size decreases as the size of the particle becomes smaller.

The microstructure of the extruded alloy consists of an ultraﬁne-grain magnesium matrix, with an average grain size of 444 nm, embedding a high volume fraction of ﬁne I-phase particles aligned along the extrusion direction.

attributes.location: basal planes parallel to extrusion direction along the diameter

evidence.quote: Pole ﬁgures reveal certain basal texture in which basal planes are parallel to the extrusion direction (ED), along the diameter of the extruded bar (TD), with a maximum intensity of 4 and 5 for the {0001} and {10 10} pole ﬁgures, respectively.
The material can be considered fully dense because only a small volume fraction of porosity, 0.03 ± 0.01%, is found.
